verdict.rationale: Published pricing is a fair question for a hosted memory service, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack shows a pricing page, a free tier, or per-unit rates. The open-source self-hosting option and claims about token-budget savings are adjacent points, not published pricing, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see published pricing with a free tier and per-unit rates so I can project memory costs before committing
